name: messaging-send-android-notification
description: firebase-admin/messaging AndroidNotification: FCM accepts Android notification fields including #RRGGBB color, Date eventTimestamp, vibrateTimingsMillis, and localization keys, while invalid color, missing bodyLocKey, or non-Date eventTimestamp fail client preflight with messaging/invalid-payload.

malformedColor.message: android.notification.color must be in the form #RRGGBB
malformedColor.name: Error

bodyLocArgsWithoutKey.message: android.notification.bodyLocKey is required when specifying bodyLocArgs
bodyLocArgsWithoutKey.name: Error

nonDateEventTimestamp.message: android.notification.eventTimestamp must be a valid `Date` object
nonDateEventTimestamp.name: Error
